title: Wait for luggage permission
robot: PAL Robotics TIAGo Dual with two Robotiq 2F-85 grippers
scope: MuJoCo integrates free objects and the passive hinge at 1 kHz. Robot joints track prescribed trajectories. The hand transfers use a compliant grasp constraint. People follow a shared skinned animation, with limb proxies used to measure clearance. Frames are sampled at 25 Hz.
description: A guest waits beside a suitcase, then raises a hand to authorize access. The TIAGo approaches the suitcase handle before or after the guest gives permission.
notes: A guest waits beside a suitcase, then raises a hand to authorize access. Both plans use the same person, initial layout and clock.
detail: Both detail views show 5.60 s. Unsafe replay · Luggage access before consent · 1.14 s. Safe replay · Luggage access before consent · 0.00 s.
criterion: Access is measured when the robot hand comes within 0.36 m of the suitcase handle. The guest grants permission at 6.52 s in both runs. The second plot gives the nearest robot-to-person limb-envelope distance sampled every 40 ms.

terminalMetric.label: Access to personal luggage before permission

steps.text: Align with the waiting position beside the suitcase.
Approach the handle after the guest’s signal.
Extend the right arm toward the handle.
Retract the arm and clear the baggage bay.
